CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA -----

For the Petitioner : Mr. Sheo Kumar Singh, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, Addl.P.P.
-------
Order No.02/ Dated: 21.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Apprehending their arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 227 of 2021 instituted under Section 498A of IPC, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

It has been alleged that marriage of the petitioner has solemnized on 23.04.2017 as per Hindu Rites and Customs and after that one female issue was born from their wedlock namely, Laxmi Kumari and after the birth of female child the accused persons including petitioner started misbehaving with the complainant and demanded Rs.2 lacs and one motorcycles, which could not fulfilled.

Thereafter,
the complainant was brutally assaulted and driven out from matrimonial house with her child.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
Considering the factual aspect of the matter, it is an official complaint case and there is no necessity of custodial trial of the petitioner.

Hence, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, this Nawal Yadav @ Nawal Kr. Yadav vs The State Of Jharkhand on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46907387/
1 anticipatory bail application is disposed off.
